en.headline: Michelle Wai wins Best Actress at Hundred Flowers Awards for The Last Dance
en.dek: The Hong Kong actress took the prize in Beijing on Monday for her role in the funeral-industry drama, ahead of mainland competitors.
body: Hong Kong actress Michelle Wai won Best Actress at the 38th Hundred Flowers Awards in Beijing on Monday for her performance in the local film The Last Dance.

Wai received 51 votes from the 101 on-site public judges, ahead of Gao Ye with 26 votes and Song Jia with 18. Mainland actor Yi Yangqianxi narrowly won Best Actor over Hong Kong veteran Tony Leung Ka-fai.
The Last Dance centres on a family working in the funeral industry. Wai appeared at the ceremony with a discreet plaster covering a recent lip injury sustained while filming another project.

zh.headline: 衛詩雅憑《破·地獄》奪百花獎最佳女主角
zh.dek: 香港女演員衛詩雅周一在北京第38屆大眾電影百花獎憑本地電影《破·地獄》奪最佳女主角，票數領先內地對手。
body: 香港女演員衛詩雅周一在北京舉行的第38屆大眾電影百花獎，憑電影《破·地獄》奪得最佳女主角。
她在101名現場公眾評委中獲51票，高於高葉的26票及宋佳的18票。內地演員易烊千璽則以微差擊敗香港資深演員梁家輝奪最佳男主角。
《破·地獄》講述殯葬業家庭故事。衛詩雅出席頒獎禮時唇部仍貼有膠布，早前拍攝另一作品時被玻璃割傷需縫超過50針。
